scope: Final Grade 3 page 27 author scope slice, complementary to printed pp25-26 batches; eight parent expectations, with required subparts explicitly represented.

rows.author_mathematical_scope: Draw scaled picture/bar graphs for multiple categories, and solve one- and two-step how-many-more/how-many-less comparisons using scaled bar graph data.
required_material_conditions: scaled picture graph and scaled bar graph

rows.author_mathematical_scope: Measure lengths to nearest halves and fourths of an inch using rulers; record the measurement data in line plots with whole, half, or quarter horizontal units.
required_material_conditions: nearest halves and fourths of an inch
line plot at whole, half and quarter units

rows.author_mathematical_scope: Understand area as count of unit squares: a side-one unit square has one square unit area; a plane figure covered without gaps or overlaps by n unit squares has area n square units.
Measure area by counting unit squares, including square centimeters, meters, inches, feet, and improvised units.

Relate rectangle area to multiplication and addition: tiled whole-number rectangles equal side-length products; model rectangle products; use tiling to demonstrate area a(b+c)=ab+ac and distributivity; decompose rectilinear figures into non-overlapping rectangles and add their areas.
required_material_conditions: required subparts a b c d

rows.author_mathematical_scope: Solve polygon perimeter problems, including given side lengths, unknown side lengths, equal perimeters with different areas, and equal areas with different perimeters.
Classify shapes by shared attributes and broad categories, recognize rhombuses, rectangles and squares as quadrilaterals, and draw quadrilaterals outside those three subcategories.
Partition shapes into equal-area parts and express each part's area as a unit fraction of the whole.
